weapon.howTo: Edit the typed WEAPONS registry; keep weapon execution in the combat mode.

boss.description: Add or change a boss definition or fight behavior.
boss.howTo: Keep boss stats in BOSSES and reusable fight mechanics in bossFight; chapters reference the boss id.

mode.description: Add or change a registered minigame mode.
mode.howTo: Run `npm run agent:scaffold-mode -- <modeId>`, implement the lifecycle, and update the scoped mode reference.

chapter.description: Add or change declarative chapter content.
chapter.howTo: Run `npm run agent:scaffold-chapter -- <index> <slug>` for a minimal config, then register it after content and music are ready.

persistence.description: Change settings, progress, save migration, or Hall of Records persistence.
persistence.howTo: Route all persisted state through the versioned omega-save-v2 API in settings.ts; never add a localStorage key.

react-bridge.description: Change communication between React UI and the Phaser scene.
react-bridge.howTo: Keep GameLayout as the host; put callback-bearing story/QTE lifecycles in focused hooks using refs and effects outside state updaters.

dialogue.description: Change dialogue, choices, beat routing, or narrative progression.
dialogue.howTo: Define story flow with typed beats; keep execution in BeatEngine and presentation in GameLayout/DialogueBox.

map.description: Change map themes, procedural scenery, props, walls, or scene layout.
map.howTo: Keep layout declarative in chapter map configs and reusable rendering behavior in MapBuilder/Atmosphere.

audio.description: Add or change music, sound effects, loading, or volume mixing.
audio.howTo: Register URLs and chapter keys in audio.ts; keep playback and per-track mixing in AudioController.

assets.description: Add or change Phaser image, sprite, prop, or chapter asset loading.
assets.howTo: Put chapter-only image keys/URLs in a typed chapter manifest; keep reused images and first-build atlas sources in the shared loading pipeline.

sprites.description: Change sprite-sheet preprocessing, segmentation, or animation extraction.
sprites.howTo: Keep pixel algorithms pure in SpritePreprocessor/PropExtractor and Phaser texture registration in SpriteLoader.

scoring.description: Change run scoring, records, ghost targets, or chapter bests.
scoring.howTo: Keep score calculation pure in scoring.ts and persistence in settings.ts.

playtesting.description: Change terminal game control, state observation, evidence, or agent protocol behavior.
playtesting.howTo: Use GameAgent for browser control, protocol.ts for JSONL contracts, and cli.ts only for command orchestration.

validation.description: Choose and run compact verification for changed code.
validation.howTo: Pass changed files to agent:check for focused verification; use check:agent for the compact full type, lint, unit, and build gate.

external-game.description: Change iframe-hosted minigames or their postMessage bridge.
external-game.howTo: Keep iframe mounting in React, mode lifecycle in external.ts, and each served bridge under public/minigames/<gameId>.

ui-settings.description: Change player settings controls or settings presentation.
ui-settings.howTo: Read and write the unified settings store; keep modal presentation isolated from persistence logic.

combat.description: Change boss combat, projectiles, attacks, damage, phases, or power-ups.
combat.howTo: Keep encounter behavior inside bossFight, shared data in entities, and player movement/fire behavior in PlayerController.
